title_cn: 司法部部长迪隆就选举安全问题与特朗普合作
summary: Assistant US Attorney General for Civil Rights Harmeet Dhillon says the Department of Justice is part of the executive branch and reports to the president. She says it's "ludicrous" to think the DOJ should be independent. She also says the DOJ will be deploying 1,000 monitors to make sure the midterm elections are secure. She speaks on "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Zambia President Cements Vote Lead as Shooting Amps Tension
title_cn: 赞比亚总统巩固投票领先地位，紧张局势加剧
summary: Zambia’s president extended a commanding lead in the nation’s election, though a shootout at the home of the main opposition leader raised tensions in Africa’s second-largest copper producer.

title: Colombia Taps New US Envoy to Rebuild Ties With Washington
title_cn: 哥伦比亚任命新任美国特使重建与华盛顿的关系
summary: Colombia President Abelardo de la Espriella named former Foreign Minister María Consuelo Araújo his new ambassador to the US as he seeks to rebuild ties after years of tensions under his predecessor.

title: Russia Is Already Waging Hybrid War in Europe, Latvia Says
title_cn: 拉脱维亚称俄罗斯已经在欧洲发动混合战争
summary: Russia’s hybrid war in Europe has already begun, Latvian President Edgars Rinkevics said, following warnings of Moscow’s attempts to intimidate nations supporting Ukraine.

title: Wealth Tax: Mark Cuban Blasts Ro Khanna for Proposing Founders Get Loan
title_cn: 财富税：马克·库班抨击罗·卡纳建议创始人获得贷款
summary: Mark Cuban lashed out at Silicon Valley Congressman Ro Khanna over the Democratic lawmaker’s proposal that the government should lend money to billionaires with large paper fortunes to help them pay wealth taxes.
